name: com.makegamesplay.webbuildhost
description: Host a Unity Web (WebGL/WebGPU) build locally with the right Content-Encoding / wasm / COOP+COEP headers, an optional self-signed HTTPS LAN URL and a Cloudflare quick-tunnel for phone testing, plus a live per-device console that streams each connected browser's logs back into the editor. Dependency-free: a tiny native server, no Python or Node required.
